plugins.name: Page Scanner
plugins.description: DOM traversal, element detection, WebSocket chunk sender, red outline highlighting. The core scanner plugin for AR Web.

plugins.name: Plugin Test
plugins.description: Smoke-test plugin that verifies the plugin loading pipeline. Shows a green overlay and logs to console.

plugins.name: Hover Pick
plugins.description: Mouse tracking with coordinate overlay. Click any element to select it, auto-detects iframes and shadow DOM.

plugins.name: Search List
plugins.description: Synchronous element list extraction. Scans the page and returns all found elements as a single JSON payload.

plugins.name: Search List Async
plugins.description: Async element extraction with Selenium executeAsyncScript callback. Used by PerformListElements for in-process scanning.
